test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the Indian music personality.

Under him the shehnai came out of its ceremonial context and began to be acknowledged as a classical music instrument.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ustad Bismillah Khan**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** was a **shehnai virtuoso from India.**
 
• He brought the shehnai, a wind instrument traditionally played in ceremonies, into the concert stage, and was instrumental in elevating its status to that of a classical instrument.
 
• He was awarded India's highest civilian honor,** the Bharat Ratna, in 2001.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alla Rakha: **

 
 
• Ustad Alla Rakha was an internationally acclaimed Indian tabla player.
 
• He was renowned for his virtuoso accompaniment and solo performances.
 
• He popularized Indian percussion music worldwide, often performing with renowned sitar player Pandit Ravi Shankar.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan: **
 
 
• Pandit Ram Narayan is an internationally acclaimed Indian musician, considered by many as the finest sarangi player.
 
• He is credited with bringing the sarangi, a bowed, short-necked string instrument, into the solo limelight from its traditional role as an accompanying instrument in Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Bundu Khan: **
 
 
• Ustad Bundu Khan was a prominent sarangi player from the traditional Indian subcontinent.
 
• He was known for his unique style and contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• He served at the court of the princely state of Jodhpur and later migrated to Pakistan after the partition of India in 1947.
